name: elearning-studio
description: Plataforma independiente de autoría e-learning con exportación SCORM 1.2 / 2004.

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w @studio/web && npm run build -w @studio/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/schema && tsc -p packages/runtime && tsc -p packages/publisher && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
